subject: RRO 8.0.2 installation missing the Revobase package

messages.author: b861660cb7de66e5
messages.subject: RRO 8.0.2 installation missing the Revobase package
parts:
I just installed RRO 8.0.2 on my windows 7 PC but looks like the Revobase package was not installed properly as the previous RRO 8.0.1 release. I run the following script from the benchmark script provided on the RRO website and I saw the following.

> if(require(Revobase)){
+   setMKLthreads(2)
+ }
Loading required package: Revobase
Warning message:
In library(package, lib.loc = lib.loc, character.only = TRUE, logical.return = TRUE,  :
  there is no package called ‘Revobase’
 

I went to the library directory and I didn't see the Revobase package. Not sure why it happened, I tried to unintall and re-install RRO 8.0.2 again, but it still doesn't work.Any one can help me figure this out?

messages.author: 88275a537c4bd7d2
messages.subject: Re: [RRO] RRO 8.0.2 installation missing the Revobase package
parts:
Hi Qingyun,

On Windows and Linux, to enable the MKL and install the Revobase package you will also need to download and install the "MKL Math Library" installer from the downloads page. You can find more info in the installation instructions.

There is no separate installer on Mac because multi-threading is provided by the native Accelerate Framework. There's also no separate Revobase package for Mac -- it's not required as the Accelerate Framework sets the number of threads automatically.

Cheers,
# David Smith
